description: BodyGuard gates access to the restaurant interior.

nodes.speaker: bodyguard
nodes.text: Turn around unless you booked a table or brought me a reason to care.

options.text: I only need five minutes with Big Boss.

nodes.speaker: bodyguard
nodes.text: Now you are speaking my language. Fine. Do not make me regret letting you past the door.

nodes.speaker: bodyguard
nodes.text: Then bring me a better argument than your face.
